scope: Independent frozen integrity and raw registry/source association inspection only; pinned sources read as text, never imported or executed.

msal.association_limit: Direct lightweight tag-to-commit plus commit-addressed source bytes; no source signature, installed version or wheel-build binding.

authlib.association_limit: Direct lightweight tag-to-commit plus commit-addressed source bytes; no source signature, installed version or wheel-build binding.

source_inspection.observation: Current acquisition decodes ID claims without validation; code-flow nonce is separately checked. Legacy decoder is deprecated.
S256 verifier retention and state comparison are source paths, not JWT verification or Hengshi authority.
Default Requests client/blocking path and added offline_access scope/exclusion; alternative wrapper/store/network qualification remains.
Server cache plus browser-session marker; no-cache data is session-held. Separate get/delete, with no atomic consume guarantee or exp check in this read path.
Base TTL 3600 seconds is a library default, not selected Hengshi transaction expiry. Session cleanup does not establish expiration enforcement before token exchange.
Read and clear are separate; ID-token parsing requires token and nonce keys; default leeway120.

Custom claim options replace discovery issuer defaults; metadata algorithm list or defaultRS256; external joserfc signature decode path, key-id refresh and nonce_supported false bypass. No full lower-library conformance proof.
Async HTTPX integration documented; illustrative automatic parsing/logout-session storage does not override Hengshi controls.

limits: No graph resolution, source execution/import, network, package installation, grants, OIDC conformance, current account/API eligibility, native trial or production selection; external guidance links beyond saved sources are not independently refetched.
